description: The Seanad of the Irish Free State (1922-1936): the 1922 nominations and election by the Dáil, the 1925 popular election, the 1928, 1931 and 1934 elections by the Oireachtas, and the by-elections, as the sources hold them (facts and citations only). Written by scripts/ingest/seanad/free_state_sources.py from the Houses of the Oireachtas member lists (member codes, membership dates) and Wikipedia's articles on each Seanad and on the 1922 and 1925 elections. An event is filed under the day its members' term began in the Oireachtas list (pollDate is the day of the poll, where a source gives it). candidatesRecorded 'winners': only the winners are on record here.
